A brief characterization of the electric arc furnace (EAF) as the object of research is provided, along with a concise description of the peculiarities of the steelmaking technological process and the existing cooking profiles. Statistical data from a large sample of heats is analysed, part of which was conducted using old control algorithms for oxygen injectors and carbon-containing material injectors, while the other part was conducted using a new algorithm that utilizes information about the harmonic composition of electric arc currents. Based on the obtained information, experimentally justified conclusions are made regarding the effectiveness of the new algorithm and its impact on the energy consumption of the furnace installation.

articleTitle: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles for Inspection of Power Lines
abstract: Problem Statement. New unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) technology has become more accessible and practical for transmission line inspection. In this paper, we propose a multi-platform UAV system and a multi-model communication system designed for high-efficiency transmission line inspection tasks. Different UAVs perform both long-range and short-range surveillance functions, and provide communication relay. High-quality images and videos are transmitted in real time to the local control station for UAV navigation and to the remote office for analysis. Practice shows that joint inspection using multiple UAVs can significantly outperform traditional inspection methods. Objective. To propose a new method for inspecting and checking the condition of power lines using several types of UAVs using certain signal transmission and relay methods. Results. A new concept of power line inspection using joint actions of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is proposed. The functional capabilities of the UAVs and the communication system are considered and discussed. Practical experience shows that due to joint work, the time spent on inspection can be significantly reduced and the efficiency can be significantly increased. The feasibility and advantages of inspections using UAVs are confirmed. Future work can focus on optimizing the configuration of UAVs as part of a group. Practical significance. The presented method allows increasing the efficiency of inspection and testing of power transmission lines in comparison with existing methods.

articleTitle: Determination of Chemical Mixture Viscosity by Means of Machine Learning Methods
abstract: Mathematical modeling of petrochemical, oil refining and oil treatment processes is an integral part of the systems of pre-project analysis of newly created, operability of operating plants, as well as systems of automated control of technological processes. Chemical-technological processes are multi-level complex systems, the hierarchy of which varies depending on the process in progress. Each of the hierarchy levels is represented by a system of equations of varying complexity, which is further reduced to a system of nonlinear equations including transcendental functions. The solution of such systems requires considerable time even when using modern computational methods, which is unacceptable, especially when used in advanced process control systems. In this paper we propose a method of calculating the viscosity of a broad fraction of hydrocarbons based on the use of machine learning models, namely neural networks. In order to accelerate training and obtain the result, the decomposition of the initial problem into a set of tasks, less parametric, which facilitates the process of training the model. Thanks to this decomposition, for a number of regions of the feature space, there is no need to calculate viscosity. To solve the problem of calculating the viscosity of a chemical mixture, a program complex was created to ensure the interaction of trained neural networks.

articleTitle: Digital Twin-Driven Decision-Making Support Approach in Adaptive Control of Production Systems
abstract: The development and applications of digital twin-driven Decision Support Systems (DSS) are discussed. In order to combine the advantages and features of model-driven, data-driven, knowledge-driven, documentation-driven and communication-driven concepts a hybrid approach for DSS design and development is proposed. Basic methods and paradigms of the concepts mentioned above are applied in implementation of hybrid approach. This approach is based on application of digital twins, adaptive digital twins in particular, for solving adaptive control problems in production systems context. A conceptual model of the architecture of adaptive digital twins of production systems is presented. The architecture of the adaptive digital twin has a hierarchical structure and is divided into three levels: 1) visualization and control level (visualization subsystem - human-machine interface; automated control subsystem); 2) simulation and optimization level (simulation subsystem (adaptive multi-agent simulation model; machine learning module); optimization subsystem); 3) data processing and storage level (subsystem of data acquisition, processing, aggregation and storage; data mining subsystem; big data analysis subsystem). The proposed concept for the development of adaptive digital twins is based on the application of an integrated approach combining methods of simulation, artificial intelligence, optimization, decision-making support, control theory, data processing, storage and analysis (including big data), etc.

articleTitle: Advanced Noise-Resistant Electrogastroenterological Classification Employing Convolutional Neural Networks and Hybrid Wavelet Transform Denoising
abstract: Analysis of electron gastroenterological signals is one of the urgent issues in the diagnosis and treatment of gastrointestinal diseases. The correct analysis of these signals is significantly affected by various noises and distortions since there is a specific mechanism for obtaining information from living organisms. The main goal of this study is to improve the results of the classification of electron gastroenterological signals by using various noise elimination methods to increase the accuracy of the diagnosis of gastrointestinal diseases. In the study framework, multiple noises were added to electrogastroenterological signals to model real conditions. To eliminate these noises, wavelet transform, median filter, Gaussian filter, and a hybrid method of wavelet and median filters were used. The results of the study showed that the proposed hybrid method is significantly more effective than other methods. The multiscale analysis capabilities of the wavelet transform and the ability of the median filter to preserve important signal features played a key role in achieving these results, and will also prove important in future research and the development of real-time EGG applications.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Micro Defect Detection for Aerospace-Grade Metal Surface Quality Control in Smart Manufacturing
abstract: In the context of Industry 4.0 and Smart Industry, automated and precise quality control systems are essential for maintaining high standards in manufacturing processes. This paper introduces an advanced approach for detecting micro defects on metal surfaces, leveraging the YOLO11 object detection algorithm to meet the stringent demands of modern industrial environments. Micro defects, such as cracks and fractures on metal surfaces, can compromise structural integrity and lead to costly failures, making their detection crucial. In this study, we categorize micro defects into four distinct types, linear, curved, point, and branched, and employ a synthetic defect generation process to create an extensice set of defect variations, subsequently augmented to enhance training diversity. The YOLO11 algorithm is trained and tested across this extensive dataset, achieving high precision and recall rates for each defect category. Detailed precision-recall analysis indicates the model's strengths and areas for improvement, particularly with smaller, more challenging defect types. The results show YOLO11's capability to accurately detect and localize defects, identifying isolated defects, recurring process-related defects, and potential error-prone zones on the metal surfaces. These capabilities align with Industry 4.0's goals of leveraging AI-driven automation to enhance quality control processes, enabling predictive maintenance and operational efficiency.

articleTitle: On Real-Time Monitoring of Machine Learning Systems
abstract: One of the main problems for discriminant machine learning models is the fact that the real data may differ from the data on which the model was trained and tested. Moreover, in many cases, it should be considered rather as a rule. The general set of data remains unknown, the real data can be arbitrarily different from the data used during the training phase. This means that generalizations of the model obtained at the training stage may not work, and the metrics obtained and confirmed by testing may not be performed. This, in turn, means that during the operation (industrial operation) of the machine learning model, it is necessary to monitor the correspondence between the characteristics of real data and the characteristics of training data. This is one of the main points in monitoring running machine learning models. The definition of the so-called data shift is necessary to determine the moment of decreasing the reliability of the results of the model, or to determine the fact that it cannot be further used without updating. At the same time, the data shift itself is heterogeneous in its impact and manifestation characteristics. The present article is devoted to the consideration of data shift analysis.

articleTitle: Environmental Monitoring System in a Smart City Based on Urban Infrastructure
abstract: With the increasing environmental burden and the rapid development of cities, the need for eco-monitoring is increasing. Existing infrastructure, such as city clocks or street lighting poles, can be used to collect environmental data in large cities. It is advisable to use a mobile network for data transmission. For these purposes, SIM800 series modems are suitable, which connect to the GPRS network via a SIM card. The advantage is that in all cities and regions there is a wide network coverage area with a good signal. There is a problem with the quality and power of the transmitting signal in areas with poor coverage. In this article, we discuss the possibility of developing a device for monitoring the environmental situation in the city and technical solutions to improve the quality of reception and transmission of the GPRS signal. Based on the prototype, it was possible to identify the prospects for using such devices and evaluate the effectiveness of the data collection system.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Modelling Stochastic Systems Using Dynamic Probabilistic Automata
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach to modeling stochastic systems using Dynamic Probabilistic Automata (DPA), which integrates deterministic and stochastic elements within a unified framework. Traditional methods, such as Markov chains or mass service systems, often struggle with high-dimensional state spaces and complex interactions. DPA overcomes these limitations by enabling flexible modeling of systems with a high degree of uncertainty. It combines probabilistic transitions, deterministic rules, and external influences, making it suitable for diverse applications in biology, economics, physics, and beyond. The proposed methodology supports custom interaction rules, scenario forecasting, and computational optimization. It includes a hierarchical structure that connects stochastic processes, individual object properties, and aggregated meta-states, culminating in a global “world” model. This layered design enables the modeling of complex phenomena, such as rare events, dynamic environmental influences, and high-dimensional interactions. An important feature is DPA's ability to address inverse modeling problems, identifying potential configurations and rules leading to specific outcomes. This has significant implications for decision support systems, optimization tasks, and risk analysis. Future work involves enhancing this framework with big data capabilities, machine learning for parameter calibration, and parallel computing for real-time applications. The flexibility and adaptability of the DPA approach establish it as a powerful tool for advancing our understanding and management of complex systems under uncertainty.

articleTitle: Identification Based on the Optimal Information Structure of Non-Stationary Objects
abstract: Scientific and methodological foundations have been developed for optimizing the identification of non-stationary objects based on the optimal information structure with mechanisms for selecting an adequate model, reducing excess space, highlighting, dividing random time series, clustering, and forecasting, subject to a priori limitations and parametric uncertainty of processes. The effectiveness of using identifiers based on dynamic models combined with a neural network has been studied. Algorithms for combined statistical and dynamic models and neural networks of various architectures have been implemented. Tools for modeling processes and presenting statistical, dynamic and specific characteristics were obtained. The computational schemes of network components with mechanisms for setting variables, optimization, and adaptive network training have been improved.v A cognitive analysis of variables has been implemented taking into account structural complexity, stochasticity of element connections based on a stochastic regression model, by tracking the ambiguity of dynamics. Optimization problems based on the probabilistic risk function and sliding control were solved. A generalized algorithm for identifying non-stationary objects is constructed based on tools for identifying boundaries, the general range of element values, selecting informative elements, and generating training sets. An identification software package was implemented in C++ in the parallel computing environment “CUDA”.
